title: Indo-Aid — Madagascar Maritime Single Window, 2026
description:
"Madagascar a bénéficié d'un financement de plus de 3,4 milliards de roupies indonésiennes, soit environ 816 millions d'ariary, à travers l'Agence indonésienne pour le Développement international (Indo-Aid). Ces fonds serviront à déployer le Maritime Single Window, une plateforme numérique destinée à centraliser les procédures administratives portuaires. Ce financement a été accordé à l'occasion du lancement officiel du projet Integrate à Jakarta, le 27 juillet, dans le cadre de la coopération bilatérale entre Madagascar et l'Indonésie."

The programme also carries a capacity-building component: fifteen Malagasy experts will train in Indonesia, and six Indonesian experts will travel to Madagascar to support a Gap Analysis and the harmonisation of administrative procedures ahead of deployment, per IMO FAL Convention standards.
original_amount: IDR 3.4 billion (~MGA 816 million, as stated by the source, 7 August 2026)

title: Digital and Energy Connectivity for Inclusion in Madagascar Project
description: Expands access to electricity and broadband internet in rural Madagascar, covering last-mile connectivity and digital infrastructure for underserved communities. Combines digital and energy components.

title: Madagascar Safety Nets and Resilience Project \u2014 Mobile Money Delivery Component
description: Digital payment delivery sub-component (~$25M imputed of $250M total) of the Madagascar Safety Nets and Resilience Project. Supports mobile money integration for direct cash transfer delivery, beneficiary digital ID registration, and electronic payment systems for social protection.

title: Airtel Mobile Money Madagascar \u2013 Digital Financial Services Guarantee
description: MIGA political risk guarantee covering The Rise Fund II Aurora S.à r.l. (TPG private equity) equity investment in Airtel Mobile Commerce B.V.'s subsidiary providing Airtel Money digital financial services in Madagascar. Services include mobile wallet (cash-in/cash-out), airtime recharging, bill payments, merchant payments; with international transfers, savings and microloans in some markets. Risks: war and civil disturbance, expropriation, transfer restriction and inconvertibility for up to 5 years.

title: Digital Governance and Identification Management System Project
description: Supports Madagascar's digital governance and national ID system through digital identification infrastructure, e-government platforms, and digital financial services.

title: China Eximbank provides RMB 337.9 million government concessional loan for Telecommunications Network Modernization Project
description: On December 2, 2019, China Eximbank and the Government of Madagascar signed a preferential loan framework agreement for the Telecommunications Network Modernization Project. Then, on February 19, 2020, China Eximbank and the Government of Madagascar signed a RMB 337,998,700 (USD 42.7 million) government concessional loan (GCL) agreement for the project. The GCL carries the following borrowing terms: a 30 year maturity, a 5 year grace period, a 1.5% interest rate, a 0.25% management fee, and a 0.25% commitment fee.   Madagascar’s Senate approved the loan agreement on June 5, 2020. This project involves the deployment of a fiber-optic network using Huawei’s 4G eLTE technology across public safety and other government agencies in the capital, Antananarivo. This project also involves the creation of data management centers and the installation of software and equipment, including video-conferencing technology and surveillance cameras, intended to improve public services and reduce the cost of internal telecommunications within public administration. Huawei Technologies is the contractor responsible for implementation.

title: WeLight Solar Mini-Grid and Rural Electrification \u2014 Madagascar
description: Norfund is a co-founding equity shareholder in WeLight, established 2018 by Axian Group, Sagemcom, and Norfund. WeLight provides solar mini-grids with digital metering to rural communities in Madagascar (primary) and expanding to Mali. 2023 secured EUR 40M additional funding (EIB EUR 9.5M + EDFI ElectriFI + Triodos EUR 19M; Norfund shareholder loan EUR ~3M). Axian Group integration links to telecom infrastructure. Digital scope: digital smart metering, IoT energy monitoring, mobile payment for energy.

title: World Bank — Madagascar Financial Inclusion Project, 2018
description: The Madagascar Financial Inclusion Project (P161491), a US$45 million IDA investment operation approved 28 February 2018 to promote financial inclusion of individuals and MSMEs. Documented via the project's 2021 COVID-era restructuring paper (Report No. RES47803).

title: Madagascar Statistical Capacity Building
description: Strengthens capacity of the National Statistics Institute (INSTAT) to produce quality statistics and enhance statistical dissemination practices. Supports national statistical system modernization including household surveys, national accounts, price statistics, and development of statistical dissemination systems. Includes data quality frameworks and statistical capacity building programs.
